description: Letter from Georgia O'Keeffe to Anita O'Keeffe Young. Georgia enclosed a typed note from Caroline Keck stating, "Painting is in special case, which also contains metal separation strip for glass, and is planned for continued travel usage - opens one end by screw-bolts, slot for painting made by Lebron. Hahn's Warehouse awaiting instruction."
maker: O'Keeffe, Georgia, 1887-1986, Keck, Caroline K. (Caroline Kohn), 1908-2007
title: Georgia O'Keeffe to Anita O'Keeffe Young
